sources.title: mansoorhamidzadeh/ag-news-bert-classification · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The AG-News BERT Classification model is a fine-tuned BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) model designed for text classification tasks, specifically for classifying news articles into four categories: World, Sports, Business, and Sci/Tech.

sources.title: PDF AI-Enabled Fake News Detection using BERT Language Model and Light GBM ...
sources.snippet: The project "AI-Enabled Fake News Detection Using BERT Language Model and Light GBM Classifier" is developed to provide an efficient and user-friendly solution for detecting fake news articles. The application is designed as an Android-based system using Java/XML and integrated with Firebase services for real-time data handling and AI support.
